reviews.text:
I cannot thank Dr. Vinod Dhunna and his team enough for the amazing care they provided to my bunny during such a frightening and stressful time.

My bunny suffered a serious injury, and we were turned away by two different animal emergency hospitals because they did not treat small or exotic pets. I was extremely distressed and worried about my bunny, and thankfully, we found Dr. Dhunna and his wonderful team.

From the moment we arrived, they were kind, compassionate, professional, and knowledgeable. They treated my bunny with such care and made sure she received the attention she needed. During a time when I was feeling overwhelmed and scared, their kindness and reassurance meant so much to me.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking such wonderful care of my bunny when we needed help the most! 🐰
Thank you Michael  for your kind review.

My dog loves Dr. Dhunna and his team. He and his clinic always make time to see her, even on short notice. He consistently listens to our concerns regarding the unique bloodwork levels that can appear in greyhounds and understands her individual needs. In contrast, there is another veterinary clinic on Hastings that requires at least two weeks' notice before scheduling an appointment, as if they are only available for routine annual visits. The team here always compliments my dog on how good and sweet she is and take very good care of her.
Please go to this animal hospital! They actually love their jobs. This was the first place that my dog was calm at. I’ll never go anywhere else.

Exceptional emergency care by the team and Dr Vinod who saved my cat Taffy during a severe urinary blockage crisis. They were fast, extremely knowledgeable, and kept me informed every step of the way. I am forever grateful for their dedication and compassion.

The team at 1st Ave Animal Hospital is absolutely wonderful. Dr. Dhunna and his team have seen my cats for almost 10 years now. One of my sphynx cats Fern has extreme allergies and Dr. Dhunna has provided excellent care over the years. He is direct, doesn’t push unnecessary procedures, and pricing is always very fair. The team of vet techs are so wonderful and many have been there for many years. Very friendly and engaged staff! Thank you for doing what you do!
Super helpful staff. Recently I went there for a second opinion the doctor knew right away what was wrong and help my dog. Im super grateful for the staff and the doctor

Dr. Dhunna is kind and takes time to inform you on how to care for our pets.  He was first recommended by my parents who he helped stitch up their dog Suni when she was bitten by another dog. He helped them at the end of his work day and even took car off my dad's scrapes. I've since taken my 2 cats to him and he's been very attentive to their issues with UTI, injuries, and behaviours. He's given me great information and options to care for my cats. Our family trust him to care for all our pets and appreciative he is in our community.
Thank you for your review Alex!
Very happy with the dental cleaning for my mini goldendoodle. I highly recommend them!
Great staff.  Fair prices.
5 stars isn't enough for this vets has been brilliant with my cat and dog, couldn't recommend anymore the best in the city
Took my guinea pigs for their first checkup and nail trim.  Dr. Dunna and his helpers were very gentle and thorough.

I have been taking my dog to 1st Ave Vet Clinic for 11 years. While my dog, that is a nervous rescue, hates going to the vet, i have had only very professional, compassionate care, support and advice from the doctors and staff at 1st Avenue. They do their best to be cost effective which i appreciate.
Pippa

We went to the emergency vet with our dog recently, and through their exam they incidentally discovered a mass on his spleen. I was advised to book in a consult and that there would be long wait times for diagnostic ultrasound. I went into 1st ave, as this is our regular vet, on Saturday and had my boy booked in for ultrasound on Monday! He had that and some samples taken to send off for testing today. Everyone at 1st ave is so kind and patient, my dog is incredibly anxious and they always work with us as much as possible to do what it takes to lessen his anxiety…and mine. He even got a little mani pedi while he was under sedation for no extra charge. Thanks to the whole team for working with an anxious dog mom, and her anxious boy, we appreciate you so much!

10/10 recommend this vet to everyone!!

I originally found them because their pricing is super fair compared to other clinics in the Lower Mainland, and honestly, they’ve been amazing from day one.

My dog has had everything done here—vaccines, tests, spaying, deworming, general health checks—and I’ve always felt like she’s in really good hands. The staff keep you updated the whole time, especially for procedures like spaying, which makes such a difference if you’re an anxious pet owner.

I’ve also been working with them to import my dog to Australia, which is a super strict and long process (about 6 months). They’ve gone above and beyond—helping with research (which another clinic told me they wouldn’t do), contacting manufacturers directly for products they didn’t have, and honouring the original quotes they gave me even when prices went up. On top of that, they’ve credited or waived fees multiple times, even though their pricing is already very reasonable. I’ve easily saved thousands by coming here instead of other vets in the area.

The staff are always friendly and easy to talk to, and you can tell they genuinely care about the animals. They also have a sweet disabled dog named Daisy who stays at the clinic, which makes the place feel extra warm—your pet will never feel alone.

Overall, just a really kind, honest, and helpful team. I’m very glad I found them.

We are so fortunate our pup was able to be treated under Dr. Dhunna and his wonderful team. For the past couple of weeks our pup was lethargic and wasn’t eating at all. After several rounds of IV fluids and tests, it was difficult to come to a conclusion on what was wrong. However, throughout the process, the team always made us feel safe and welcoming each time we visited and the doctor was always considerate of our financial situation. After two weeks we finally got a diagnosis of a rare disease and started treatment immediately. I could not be more thankful to Dr. Dhunna and his team for providing the highest quality of care and support!

My animal’s euthanasia was not treated with respect in his final moments. They tried to give the final injection before he was properly sedated. He was moving.

They used a box as an induction chamber. If he squirmed in their hands, in the 5 seconds it took to transfer him from the induction box to the table, he was not properly sedated.

I had to scream at them that they didn’t wait long enough, for them to put him back into the gas for a second round.

When they took him out the second time, he was properly limp for the injection. This proves that they rushed the procedure. I understand gas wears off quickly and they need to move fast. But he was moving the second they took him out. There’s a difference between wearing off and not reaching the final stage of sedation

Had I not intervened, my baby would have felt the needle to his heart. He only had a pain free death because I advocated.

On top of that, while I was crying over the body, they moved to water cooler talk behind me. Discussing schedules and other patients. They ignored my pain and treated it like a checklist to get over. Discussing to do lists while someone mourns their companion is a massive violation of the silent vigil that was supposed to follow death.

Over all, their clinical detachment was a violation of care for an owner and the patient. My hamster may have been a small pet, but he still deserved proper treatment. I know they would not have attempted to inject a squirming dog.

I am not posting this as hate. This is awareness that they need to do better for future clients of small creatures. In euthanasia, care extends to empathy for the owner, not just stopping the heart. It should never be a rushed process, and it does not end once the injection is done. You carry that empathy for as long as the person is in the room, not switch to schedule and logistics mode

Woke up to a weird thing on my cat's pupil. I called this vet and they were able to squeeze me in for a visit immediately, even though I was a new patient! According to the good doctor, my senior cat is either developing cataracts or has a fat deposit in her eye 🥲 the wellness exam was $50. They have earned my cat and my business. …
Thank you Khyati

They took care of my dogs for sometime, until one of my dogs got really ( seriously ) sick and was misdiagnosed. My dog now has cancer in a terminal stage and there's no much I can do anymore - the vet told me I had nothing to worry about "it is just a cyst". Although staff is friendly and they are very accommodating schedule-wise this is the type of error that cannot be taken back. Don't recommend for anything that is not trivial.

The doctor and his staff are such nice people! A very honest and straightforward veterinarian. He will help you with true facts  and pertinent treatment and will save you money in doing so. Recommended!

I’ve been seeing Dr. Dhunna at East 1st Ave Animal Hospital for almost five years, and I felt compelled to leave a detailed review after reading some of the negative comments here.

Our family brings two Frenchies and a cat to Dr. Dhunna, and my brother’s family now brings their two cats as well. Over the years, Dr. Dhunna has consistently shown himself to be very knowledgeable, thorough, and honest. He always clearly explains the issue, answers questions patiently, and provides multiple treatment options rather than pushing one solution.

One thing I especially appreciate is his transparency with cost. He is very understanding of financial concerns and has never pressured us into unnecessary or expensive procedures. In fact, our experience has been the opposite of some comments mentioning high costs. My brother was once quoted over $1,800 CAD for a grade 1 dental cleaning for his cat at another clinic in East Vancouver. We went to Dr. Dhunna for a second opinion, and he explained that the issue was not urgent, provided preventive advice, and clearly outlined when dental cleaning would actually be necessary. The same procedure was quoted at $600 CAD per cat.

But I also want to clarify something for readers who may be concerned about cost. For proper diagnosis, procedures like blood work, urine analysis, X-rays, or ultrasounds are often necessary, not optional. Without these diagnostic tests, it’s simply not possible to accurately determine what’s wrong or to treat the problem safely. Because of this, a typical vet visit can easily be in the $400–$500 range, which is honestly, from experience, considered the norm for veterinary care—not something unique to this clinic.

As for comments about him seeming serious or not very friendly—yes, Dr. Dhunna can appear serious at first, but we’ve come to understand that this comes from his focus and professionalism. He is actually very easy to talk to, patient when explaining medical details, and genuinely cares about the animals he treats. Our pets have always been handled with care and respect.

Trust is incredibly important when choosing a vet, and that’s why our entire family continues to see Dr. Dhunna. He prioritizes education, preventive care, and long-term health rather than upselling treatments. Because of our consistently positive experiences, all five of our pets—two Frenchies and three cats—are under his care.

If you’re looking for an experienced veterinarian who is honest, knowledgeable, and respectful of both your pet’s needs and your financial situation, I highly recommend Dr. Dhunna.

We highly recommend Dr Dhunna and his First Avenue Hospital staff. They are professional, knowledgeable and very caring.  Our little paralyzed dog got a new lease on life after other vets had given up on him.  With a combination of holistic care and acupuncture our dog was walking again and running around after 4 months.  Thank you Dr. Dhunna and your wonderful staff.
Thank you

Last Friday, we noticed our male cat had not peed for 16 hours. With his history of urinary track blockage, we were immediately alerted. It was 5pm, and all the vets were closing. I called all the vets in the area, only 1st Ave picked up. Dr. Vinod Dhunna was so kind to take us in last minute, took an xray, then helped empty our cat’s bladder immediately. He and his team were so warm, helpful, professional, and caring. I’m transferring our babies to this hospital! Thank you team for the amazing work that you’re doing :)

Terrible experience. The vet was cold, dismissive, and seems to lack any empathy. I was given a quote but no explanation of the procedure, the medications, or any post-care instructions. Every piece of information had to be pulled out through questioning, and the responses were curt and dismissive.

I wasn’t informed that extractions might be needed in the initial check up, yet the morning of the procedure they added another $500 while my cat was already sedated and gave me only minutes to decide. This lack of transparency and urgency felt unfair and unethical, especially given that I had already discussed financial limitations.

They also opted for the most expensive medications without offering alternatives and refused any kind of payment plan.

Overall, I felt there was no empathy, no communication, and no transparency. I left feeling pressured, unprepared, and taken advantage of. I will not be returning.
This js the worse place to bring your pet. Trust me!!! They over charge for everything and thry charged me for a needle that I had no idea they administered to my puppy. The bill came up to over $400

Been taking my dog here for almost 9 years and I would not go anywhere else with her. They have always taken the best care of her and the doctor has always priced medical issues fairly. Easily the best vet in the city.

Worked with First Avenue Animal Hospital for our Dog export from Canada to New Zealand.
New Zealand is a complex country to send a dog. The team at First Avenue Animal Hospital were extremely accommodating and supportive with ensuring we were set up for success for our appointment with CFIA.
The export requirements to NZ and quarantine kennel requirements following arrival in Nz required multiple treatments, multiple vaccinations (including Canine Influenza), multiple tests, multiple declarations and certificates. The team did their homework on the requirements and helped us on their part of the process.
Fantastic place, honest and great service!

I took my cat in for a rabies shot and was very disappointed with the experience. The veterinarian was extremely rude — throwing things around and acting irritated. For the $100 I paid, I expected at least a proper check-up, but he didn’t even touch my cat or check her overall health, only looked briefly into her ears. That’s not acceptable care in my opinion. I will be taking my pet elsewhere and definitely wouldn’t recommend this clinic.

A truly compassionate and professional same day appointment with this amazing veterinarian clinic , the staff were very understanding and sensitive to my concerns , empathetic and genuinely supportive during the whole experience.
DR Dhunna was amazingly patient and very knowledgeable while addressing my cats concerns … I’m very happy to have all my worried eliminated and my pet on the road to better health
Thank you from the bottom of my heart again 🙏

Dr. Vinod Dhunna and his staff and friendly, kind, and knowledgeable. I brought my cat Virginia to 1st ave animal hospital when she was suffering from bladder stones. The surgery and recovery went perfectly. My cat is healthy and happy. Their prices are reasonable. The staff was available to answer my (frequent) questions during the recovery period. I highly recommend this clinic. Thank you! ❤️

We had a heartbreaking experience here. Our dog passed away the very same night after being given shots and medications that cost over $350. Even though it was clear she was near the end of her life, the vet pushed treatments instead of offering compassion or honest guidance. We were devastated.

When we raised our concerns, the owner dismissed any accountability. A neighbor of ours went through something similar — his 16-year-old dog was pressured into a $3,000 surgery. The dog’s quality of life declined rapidly after the procedure and he passed away soon afterward. Why couldn’t the vet simply be honest and compassionate, especially with such elderly pets?

If you’re looking for a vet who prioritizes profit over empathy, this is the place. But if you want someone who truly cares about your pet’s well-being and quality of life, I strongly recommend going elsewhere.

It was my very first time at a vet ever and I had taken a lot of time to compare the clinics in my area. This one stood out with the most positive reviews, and now I completely understand why.

I brought in my 1.5-year-old cat for a full checkup, since it was her first vet visit after I adopted her a couple of months ago. Everyone there was so kind, welcoming, and genuinely helpful. I was really anxious, since I’d often heard stories about vets pushing unnecessary procedures or costs, but that wasn’t the case at all here. They listened carefully to my concerns, gave me thoughtful advice, and fully respected my choices, which I truly appreciated !!

I’ll definitely be coming back, they’re trustworthy and so caring ! You can see it in the way they handle the animals. A huge thank you to the whole 1st Ave team : to Dr. Dhunna for taking the time to really observe my cat thoroughly, to Xenya for handling her so gently, and to Bridget for the thoughtful guidance alongside Xenya and Dr Dhunna. :)

My dog started visiting 1st Ave Vet clinic in the early summer. Dr. Dhunna and his team have been flexible with scheduling and allowing my dog to come in for treatments. He is very fair and reasonable with costs. He recently did major dental work and my dog is feeling much better and recovering well.
He likes his clean teeth
Excellent service from the team and Dr. Vinod Dhunna. Good experience for our dog Rocky! 👌 …

Really good service. Our cat wasn’t feeling well and it was late in the day. The doctor had finished his appointments for the day but stayed to wait for us. His whole team were really kind and helpful. They handled our spicy cat with ease.
The doctor took time to show us her X-rays and answer any questions we had …despite the fact that he clearly had a celebratory dinner appointment he was potentially running late for. Definitely a vet with skill and  heart.

My favourite in Vancouver! Dr Dhunna and his wife are so kind as are the rest of the team. They helped me and my big boy Romeo out in a pinch. I was so grateful for the care and compassion they showed him and I. Romeo is nervous at the vet and they were able to treat him without sedation with their low stress handling. I cannot recommend them enough!

I used to take my cat here and would recommend not seeking care for your pet here if possible. The reasons are as follows:

- My cat is not the type to growl or lash out except in extreme distress. The sounds she made when they took her into the back room were extremely alarming. She has not had that adverse reaction at other vets before or since being in their care.

- The staff are not treated well. They were always stressed and overworked, and my cat was not given the best care because of this.

- My cat had a blood test done and the tech mistakenly mislabelled the vials. Which meant I paid for them to put my cat in distress for nothing, and they asked me to come back in to redo the test which I declined.

- There was one instance where the staff made a mistake with undercharging me, and they called me in the middle of my day to say that if I did not go out of my way to come in and pay the remaining balance that they would lose their job.

Overall, there were more negative experiences than positive, and I have since been to much kinder and more competent vet clinics.

The people work there and veterans very kind, they have full of love and care
Bring your love pets to see them
Thank you so much Michael!
I always recommend this animal hospital, as I have always had a great experience. Staff genuinely care about the animals and the rates are far more reasonable than most.
My cat died here
I only take my doctor here. Everyone is amazing and take care of my baby very well

I just want to express my deepest gratitude. Such good employees – kind, smart, sensitive. Doctor Dhunna – sent by God to help our smaller brothers; he is so good. Three Angels helped us in this clinic. My cat felt better. I wish everyone health and prosperity to this clinic! Thank you!
I just want to express my deepest gratitude. Such good employees – kind, smart, sensitive. Doctor Dhunna – sent by God to help our smaller brothers; he is so good. Three Angels helped us in this clinic. My cat felt better. I wish everyone health and prosperity to this clinic! Thank you!
Amazing clinic with wonderful staff and caring doctor. And a purrfect clinic kitty :)
This vet clinic has always treated my pets well and I trust them.
Just nice people who treat the pet and their family with kindness and respect.
Clean Office, Expert and friendly team !
Dr. Dhunna is really experienced and caring. They always do their best. My dog had recurring issues and Dr. Dhunna cured it.
Amazing vet for years always considerate and helpful.

The most amazing place ever. They helped my Salem out big time! I needed him to be checked called them had me book for 11am and they treated him and out the door we went with medication and food. My cat was very comfortable with the vets and they talked so nice to me and my cat. First place I’ve ever been to that was super kind! I recommend them 10/10

Very helpful knowledge and kind hearted staff . Was super happy I brought my cat here for care as she received excellent service. Would highly
recommend this Vet. Thank you 🙏 …
Thank you! Amazing service! Phaedra was wonderful and gave us a quick painless fix for our poor kitty's face allergies 💜💜 …

This Vet really cares. We have taken our dogs here  for many years.
Recently, our dachshund Dave, became deathly  ill, and Dr. Dhunna managed a series of complex ailments which saved Dave’s life. I’m grateful to have a veterinarian I can trust. I  highly recommend 1st Ave. Animal Hospital.
We’ve been bringing our dogs here for over 5 years now & the staff are incredible. They don’t overcharge you & are super caring during our visits

Dr. Dhunna & his team are absolutely amazing! Multiple family dogs have been going to this office for over 8.5 years. Big Teddy is a regular here despite having moved to San Francisco 4 years ago. He comes back for surgeries with Dr. Dhunna & Librela injections as needed when we are here. The team truly cares for our pets. Big Teddy has a special bond with Dr. Dhunna that cannot be replicated elsewhere. Thank you for all that you all do for us!
Very grateful they are open to emerging walk-ins! They helped our dog so quickly after an accident. Nice team!!

I had a terrible experience with Dr. Vinod Dhunna, and I wouldn't trust him with any pet. My cat was diagnosed with diabetes, and he prescribed an excessive insulin dose without explaining the risks. He made it sound as simple as giving antibiotics--never mentioned the potential for seizures, comas, or death. He never mentioned a glucometer.

A couple of days after starting treatment, I came home to find my cat unresponsive, surrounded by bodily fluids. I rushed her to the clinic, where they stabilized her, but she later had a massive seizure. He told me this happens all the time. They sent her home the same night, despite the vet techs saying she was in critical condition. The vet told me she'd be fine in the morning--she wasn't. Hours later, she had seizure after seizure, and when I tried calling for help, there was no emergency line like they had said, just an answering machine.

I took her to VCA, where they said the insulin dose that Dr. Dhunna prescribed was way too high and that her glucose levels need to be monitored regularly. They tried stabilizing her, but ultimately, I had to put her down. Dr. Dhunna never followed up, never returned my calls from the night before.

To make matters worse, he also misdiagnosed my dog's heart condition and put her on the wrong meds. Thankfully, I got a second opinion, and she's okay now.

I wouldn't recommend this clinic to anyone. The staff are lovely and helpful but the doctor is incompetent and uncaring.
My cat got very sick over Christmas, and all the staff were very kind and  helpful as they helped him get healthy again.

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude for the exceptional care and patience Dr. Dhunna and their team have given to my 140 pounds boy Allen during our regular check-ups and emergency visits. Dr. Dhunna's expertise is impeccable and everyone in the team has always shown incredible kindness. I know my loved one is in the best hands!
Thanks Kourtney!

I can’t say enough good things about 1st ave animal hospital. Both my dog and my cat receive the best care here, and I always leave feeling confident with the treatment plans given. The entire staff is kind, knowledgeable, and truly cares about the well-being of the animals they treat.

Dr. Dhunna is an incredible vet who actually wants to help your pet—not just make money. He takes the time to explain everything, offers reasonable solutions, and never pushes unnecessary tests or treatments. His bedside manner is amazing; he’s gentle, patient, and makes sure both pets and owners feel comfortable.

Their emergency care is outstanding. When I’ve needed urgent help, they acted quickly and made a stressful situation much easier to handle.

On top of all that, their prices are unparalleled. The care my pets receive here is better than places that charge three times as much. Finding a vet who provides top-tier care without outrageous costs is rare, and I’m so grateful to have Dr. Dhunna and his team. I’ve moved downtown since I started seeing him and I still make the trip over there after realizing there’s honestly no better clinic. If you’re looking for a compassionate, skilled, and affordable vet, this is the place to go!

My experience with the Vet and his staff at this business were beyond my expectations. They went above and beyond to take care of my pet dog tank. I would strongly recommend bringing your pet to this fantastic business much love.

I adopted two kittens from one of the staff members, who i had been previously aqueintened  with. The mother cat was a stray Phaedra had rescued. I hadn't had a cat in 6 year since my last guy died. When my lil hamster had to be put down recently, Phaedra was extremely supportive and empathetic to my pain. Phae and I both knew in adopting the kittens we could trust each other to have their best interest at heart. Of course we decided to have all the kittens care done at First avenue.They were super friendly and competent. I find First Avenue Animal Hospital very reasonably priced. Phaedra Smith is so knowledgeable and personable, and made the whole process of adopting and caring for our boys a joy. Phaedra helped me get pet insurance, choose the right food, remind me when their shots were due, and other things. We continue to travel to first avenue from south Surrey to see Phaedra for their ongoing care.

I am impressed with everyone I have come into contact with at 1st Ave Animal Hospital. I consider the receptionist, the techs and Dr Dhunna all top notch people.

Long story not quite so short, our long-time neighbour unexpectedly passed away and we decided to take in his cherished dog Nico. We knew 1st Ave was his preferred place to go for vet care, so when Nico split one of his claws in half we knew immediately where to go to get help. I called around an hour before closing and was told to come in ASAP, which I did.

The vet and gone home for the day so they bandaged his foot and leg and told me to return in the morning. Not only was there no unnecessary upselling, there was no immediate charge for the bandaging and the collar. Sure, Nico had a history with the vet, but I didn’t. This impressed me.

I returned promptly the next morning where I met Dr Dhunna for the first time. While inspecting Nico I asked Dr Dhunna if he recognized Nico. I began to tell the story of how my neighbour unexpectedly passed and I saw the light bulb turn on in his head. He remembered my neighbour, relayed facts about him and appeared genuinely saddened and shocked at his passing. Now I don’t know how many clients he routinely sees, but regardless of that, I was impressed that he remembered my neighbour with such clarity and the empathy and concern he showed while we talked, not only for my neighbour but for Nico (my feelings extend to the receptionist and tech as well).

Nico needed his claw cut back and cauterized, as well as a teeth cleaning. Since he had to be put under for the cleaning I decided to have a small growth removed on his head as well. I was presented with a detailed breakdown of what the costs would be, (over 1K for everything), and I thought it reasonable. I did not feel as if I was being taken advantage of. Anytime you have to put an animal under it isn’t going to be cheap. A portion of the amount was paid beforehand and the remainder was paid when I picked him up later in the day. There were no additional charges that weren’t signed off on beforehand. That is how it should be…and it was.

The next morning I awoke to find Nico had somehow gotten his bandage off his front leg…apparently not uncommon. Another call and quick trip to the vet where they re-bandaged his foot and leg, but in a slightly different manner this time, which did the trick. No added charge.

Based on my experience, if you want your pet to be taken care of properly without worrying about unnecessary charges, I would recommend Dr Dhunna and the staff at 1st Avenue Animal Hospital.
Such a great Vet. The staff is always so friendly and helpful. Dr. Dhunna is professional and has been a huge part of my dog’s health over the last 7 years. Highly recommend this vet to anyone.
Dr Dhunna and his staff and so great. I’ve been taking my animals to 1st ave vet for 8 years and they always receive the very best care. I highly recommend them!
Thank you for your support.

Over the past few years I have had 3 of my rats treated here, just recently Dr.Dhunna was able to remove a huge tumor from my little girl, even thought there were risks. Within 2 weeks she was very surprisingly fully healed up and back to …
Butters is currently home from getting treated at 1st Ave Vetrinarian Clinic. After being on a 48hr watch with full triage service. He is on the mend. …

The smell of this office is atrocious. Add in me being put into a room with no one speaking to me, to wait for 30 minutes while a dog barked incessantly in the next room. I ended up leaving and will not return. Not impressed with this place
Always very kind and good at explaining what they're doing!

Excellent animal hospital in Vancouver, the doctor is kind and has lots of knowledge.
The staff is nice and would definitely recommend coming here
